title: Indian Classical Dance Forms
summary: Widely recognised Indian classical dance forms include Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Kathakali, Kuchipudi, Odissi, Manipuri, Mohiniyattam and Sattriya. Rabindra Nritya is a Bengali dance style developed from Tagore's work.
